name: My Dream Girl
source:
Max's childhood was rough. He was adopted by his neighbor Burgandi, after he lost his parents at a very early age. He witnessed their death, got traumatized, and changed. He grew up to be a somewhat decent person, but still behaved as an innocent kid with grownup body & desires. Now he is a history professor at a university, and while on a picnic to a remote abandoned castle, he decides to propose to the woman of his dreams. But a beautiful woman greets him in the castle and changes his life forever.


[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/MyDreamedUniverse]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
马克斯的童年十分坎坷。他很小便失去了父母，之后被邻居勃艮蒂收养。亲眼目睹父母死亡，让他遭受创伤，也改变了他。长大后，他算是成了个还不错的人，行为举止却仍像个天真的孩子，只是有了成年人的身体与欲望。如今，他在大学担任历史学教授。一次去偏远废弃城堡野餐时，他决定向梦中情人求婚。然而，城堡中一位美丽女子的出现，彻底改变了他的人生。

[编译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/MyDreamedUniverse]Patreon[/url]]
